description: Check a website, API, or package before you rely on it: live reachability (and official status when we have a feed), cited plan/limit facts from official pricing pages, and optional registry data (exists, latest version, deprecated or yanked). Pass a service slug from list_check_services, a public https URL to probe, and/or a package name (ecosystem: npm, pypi, crates, go). Pricing numbers always include source_url and verified_at. If a figure could not be read from the official page, the field is null — never guessed. Shares the docs lookup free daily cap (20 free lookups on a client's first day, then 5 free per day); after that $0.01 per lookup via x402 on Solana, in USDC, PYUSD, or USDT. When unpaid, the result is the x402 402 challenge.

ecosystem.description: Registry for a package check (default npm)

name.description: Package or module name to check on the official registry

paymentSignature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE from a previous 402

service.description: Service slug from list_check_services, e.g. openai, stripe, supabase

url.description: Public https URL to probe when the service is not in the catalog

name: preflight
title: Preflight a service, URL, or package
